visualCharacteristics.purpose: Service split hero: a text column (adopted breadcrumb, headline, appointment CTA with icon, service-time note) and a 4:3 image (LCP, eager) that bleeds into the right gutter from 1200px and leads the column below. Full-bleed section shell with a top band strip and section-end padding. Options: `grey` / `lavender` ground; `band-white` / `band-grey` colour of the 80px (120px from 768px) step band left of the content column (hidden below 768px); `spaced` keeps a 100px bottom padding under the hero for when rich text follows in the same section (services overview)
